notes.title: Update 0.4 – Fruit Hoops Ahoy!
notes.content:
Dear Friends and Fans, 

Welcome to our first official mini-update! We’ve heard your feedback, and we have added a handful of new features, including our first game, Fruit Hoops.  Please see below for all the necessary info. 

TO PLAY FRUIT HOOPS: 
Ask the bot “Let’s play a game”. This will teleport you to the fruit hoops court. Shoot “Start” and say the name of the fruit you wish to pick up. Then throw the fruit into the correct hoop that matches. Say and throw all the fruits into their appropriate baskets before the timer runs out! (This game is also in Beta!) 

Changelog
- attempted fix of push to talk, WIP as occasional bugs still exist
- added fruit game
- minor brain changes

If speech isn’t working, confirm speech services are on (see FAQ) and that you are connected to the internet. If problem persists, email us your log which can be found in C:\Users\{your username}\AppData\LocalLow\Infusion Edutainment\VR-TA\outputlog.txt

Aiming to make push to talk optional ASAP, but for now, it is still necessary. 

We have many further updates to come. Although we have been squashing our fair share of bugs, the known ones that still exist are as follows: 
- Fruit is sometimes interactive before being unlocked with voice
- Not clear when fruit is unlocked
- Speech service sometimes does not run on start
